name: Trend-follower trigger: MA cross → enter 18:00, flat 15:55
why: Trend-following funds (CTAs) hold rules on the 50/100/200-day averages; when yesterday's close crosses one, they must buy (sell) over the next session regardless of price. Pre-registered 2026-10-16 (research/preregistered/2026-10-16_owned_data_ideas.md).
